plugins.name: faf
plugins.description: Persistent project context for Claude Code. .faf is the IANA-registered structured file (application/vnd.faf+yaml) that captures your project's DNA — stack, goals, the 6 Ws — so Claude never has to ask "what is this project?" twice. One source generates CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, GEMINI.md. Define once, every AI reads consistent context. Cross-vendor: Claude, Cursor, Grok, Gemini.

plugins.name: faf-memory
plugins.description: etch and forget. Persistent AI memory in IANA-registered .fafm (application/vnd.fafm+yaml). Cross-vendor — Claude, Cursor, Grok, Gemini all read the same memory. Etch a fact once, recall it in any future session. No more session-zero blank slate. Nelly Never Forgets (so you can!).
